description: This file defines the base interface `Event` for all event types in the Ditto project. It includes metadata, type, revision, and timestamp methods, as well as JSON serialization support and related constant definitions.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Base interface for all event types emitted by Ditto, parameterized with the implementing class type, extending Signal and WithOptionalEntity.

classes.name: Event.JsonFields
classes.description: Container for JSON field definitions related to Event objects, including identifiers, type, revision, timestamp, and metadata fields.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new copy of the event with the specified revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the event's timestamp, if present.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the event's metadata, if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event into a JSON object including non-hidden fields.
